headline: Executive order aims to secure the U.S. supply of elemental phosphorus and glyphosate-based weed killers, calling it a national defense issue.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order treats elemental phosphorus and glyphosate-based herbicides as important to national defense and directs steps to make sure the country has enough of them. No summary was provided, so the specific actions, agencies, and legal tools involved are not known from the available information.

who_it_affects.group: Makers of elemental phosphorus and glyphosate-based herbicides
who_it_affects.how: These companies may be the focus of federal efforts to keep or increase production in the United States.

who_it_affects.group: Farmers who use glyphosate-based weed killers
who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at keeping a steady supply of these herbicides available.
